title: Prices and external pressure

blocks.heading: Prices and external pressure
blocks.text: Export revenue depends on price and quantity, while import needs create external payment requirements. A fall in export prices with unchanged quantities can reduce receipts and make essential imports harder to finance. Foreign investment provides finance through a different transaction, not an immediate export-value change.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Trading and fluctuation
blocks.text: Countries trade goods and services, directly or through organised markets and firms. A producer relying on one export faces concentrated price or demand exposure; diversification and viable processing can reduce some risks but need resources and buyers.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Payment difficulties
blocks.text: External payment pressure can arise when available foreign receipts and finance are insufficient for payment commitments. Prioritising essential needs or seeking support can help, but borrowing creates obligations and restricting imports may remove necessary productive inputs.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: A fairer economic order
blocks.text: Debates about a new economic order concern fairer participation, bargaining, access to technology and the distribution of gains in global exchange. Better terms can support development, but agreements need implementation and capacity; a declaration alone does not change productive opportunities.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Use the evidence
blocks.text: Explain the trade mechanism in this fictional case: an exporter sells the same quantity but unit price falls while essential import costs are unchanged. Export receipts fall without a matching reduction in payment needs, increasing external financing pressure.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Connect the ideas
blocks.text: Connect to Industrialisation (4.1), Production (3.1) and investment/aid (9.2). Keep transaction type, time period, units and local development criteria explicit. The data is fictional.
